story_type: boaters in the water far offshore after a shark attack, search plane spots them, boat crew and helicopter hoist
hook: 25 miles out, in the water, and a shark had already hit them.
narration: Three boaters were in the water twenty-five miles off Louisiana, and a shark had already bitten two of them.
They had been reported overdue. Coast Guard crews searched about twelve hundred and fifty square miles of the Gulf.
A Coast Guard plane from Corpus Christi found all three in the water. This is its camera.
A search plane cannot pick anyone up. It circles, keeps its camera on them, and guides the rescuers in.
A boat crew from Venice pulled two of them out before the shark could do more damage.
[short pause] Then a Jayhawk crew from New Orleans lowered its hoist for the third boater.
outcome: All three were flown to a hospital in New Orleans and were reported in stable condition.
title: Shark attack 25 miles off Louisiana
description:
On Oct. 9, 2022, Coast Guard air and boat crews rescued three overdue boaters from the water about 25 miles offshore from Empire, Louisiana, after two of them were injured in a shark attack.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Coast Guard Air Station Corpus Christi, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/860117/coast-guard-rescues-3-overdue-boaters-offshore-empire-la
